# Note on the control rows (what the results are, not only how many; read Nov 24, 2026, in a second pass, from the 80 saved result pages of all 71 database searches, whose totals equal this table's, and from the items that pass opened). 高通 (Qualcomm), 8 results, all opened: one names Qualcomm, Xinhua's report of Xi's meeting of Mar 27, 2024 with American business and academic representatives, as People's Daily printed it (Mar 28, 2024), where its chief executive is among the American guests who spoke, not in Xi's words; seven hold the two characters inside other words, 提高通过 (five) or 提高通关 (two). 微软 (Microsoft), 38 results: 17 show the word in their text, read by their result excerpts (one opened); among them Xi's own sentence naming it is his speech of Apr 19, 2016 (two copies and a 2017 compilation), and the others are reports of his 2015 visit to its headquarters and of a meeting held there, lists of guests and articles; 21, all opened, hold the word only in the font name 微软雅黑 inside a style attribute. 英特尔 (Intel), 4 results, all naming the firm: his 2016 speech (two copies), its 2017 compilation and an article of 2026-09-07. 特斯拉 (Tesla), 3 results: two are 尼古拉·特斯拉 (Belgrade's airport, items of 2024-05-09 and 2016-06-18) and one names the company (search/battery_A.txt). 超级智能 (superintelligence), 2 results: the readout of Xi's meeting with Trump of Nov 19, 2026 (the database dates the item Nov 20), where the word stands in its account of Trump's remarks, not Xi's, and an article of 2026-09-07 that names a factory, 超级智能工厂 (search/battery_A0.txt). The 13 rows of role coverage control are phrases from ten known texts of the window (three from Xinhua's report of the May 14, 2026 meeting with US executives, two from the Feb 9, 2026 visit in Beijing, one from each of eight others): nine of the ten texts were returned; for the May 14 report, 美国企业家 and 随同美国总统特朗普访华 returned nothing and 更广阔前景 returned three other texts (a message to Brazil's president, talks with Kyrgyzstan's president, a meeting with Abu Dhabi's crown prince), so its count of 3 is not a find (search/battery_E.txt, battery_F.txt). A wider test (the same second pass): of 156 Xi items of 2023 to November 2026 taken from Xinhua's lists of his activities and Qiushi's index, chosen by chip, computing-power, AI, US-firm or curb words in their text, the database holds 150; the six it lacks are the May 14, 2026 meeting and five joint statements he signed; of the 124 items whose only such word is 人工智能 (AI), 21 were checked (every eighth, and five joint statements).
